signatures: def apply(func: str, values: list) -> object
notes: apply: count -> number of non-None values (a ['*','*',...] style list counts every element, including None); sum -> total of non-None numeric values, 0 for none; avg -> float mean of non-None numeric values, None for none; min/max -> over non-None values, None for none; anything else raises ValueError(f'unknown aggregate: {func}'). func is matched lower-case. group_indices: {key_tuple: [row indices]} over a tinyq.schema.Table, keys in first-seen order, key is tuple(row[name] for name in names); names=[] yields a single group keyed by () holding every row index (and [] when the table is empty); an unknown column name raises KeyError from Table.column.
